# M3-1c: Questions, users, alerts, import state

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-1c`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-1c`
- Depends on: M3-1b
- Touches (exclusive while running): store/
- Plan refs: §2 `questions`, `users`; §5 handling rules; spikes/slack.md §Recommendation; §3.7 alert budget
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
Slack questions, user identity, event de-duplication, alert history and import state all persist across restarts.

## Scope
- Migration `0008_questions.sql`. One `questions` table per §2; no `slack_questions`.
- `questions`: id, plan_id, kind (`categorize`/`dry_run_check`), subject_id, channel_id, message_ts, options (JSON: label, category_id,
  category_name), status (`pending`/`open`/`answered`/`closed`), answer, answered_by, answered_at, close_reason, created_at. Unique
  index on (channel_id, message_ts). `pending` means decided but not yet posted because of the cap.
- `users`: slack_user_id, label (`brendan`/`wife`), upserted from config. Leave OAuth subject and fun-money columns to M4/M5.
- `slack_events`: dedupe key, seen_at, with a prune older than 7 days.
- `alerts`: id, plan_id, kind, dedupe_key, critical, status (`sent`/`rolled_up`), body, created_at.
- `import_state`: plan_id, last_attempt_at, last_ok_at, last_error (redacted text).
- `alert_cursor`: plan_id, last_first_seen_at, so the anomaly rules only see new rows across restarts.
- Accessors include `ClaimAnswer`: an atomic `UPDATE ... WHERE status='open'` that reports whether this caller won.
- Reads for later tasks, which don't touch `store/`:
  - Questions: open and pending lists, by subject, and close-with-reason.
  - Alerts: `TransactionsFirstSeenAfter(ctx, planID, t)` (non-deleted, using the mirror's `first_seen_at`) and `PayeeCharges(ctx, planID, normalizedPayee, before)` for history thresholds.
  - Dry-run report: decisions in a date range, answered `dry_run_check` questions, `CountWriteLog`, and the current human-set category for a txn with when it was first seen.

## Out of scope
- Slack calls (M3-10a), alert rules (M3-12a), scheduler changes (M3-15).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: migration applies on a DB at 0007.
- [ ] Test: lookup by (channel_id, message_ts) survives reopening the DB.
- [ ] Test: of two concurrent `ClaimAnswer` calls, exactly one wins (goroutines, `-race`).
- [ ] Test: a repeated event key reports as a duplicate; prune removes only old keys.
- [ ] Test: counts of open and pending questions; import state and the alert cursor round-trip.
- [ ] Fixture tests: `TransactionsFirstSeenAfter` excludes older and deleted rows; `PayeeCharges` respects `before`; the dry-run report reads return the expected rows.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
